summary: Focused Phase 6/7/8 verification. Backend: 11 targeted curl-equivalent pytest checks (SQL Arena security guard, challenge submit, retry engine delays, arrears state machine) — 11/11 pass. Frontend: /lab/retry-engine, /lab/arrears, /lab/sql-arena fully exercised (schema explorer 6 tables, 12 challenges, submit CORRECT, run SQL 8 rows, 3 hints, solution panel, read-only security error, Easy filter, Interview mode hiding hint/solution + timer, mobile 390x844 no overflow), /labs 4 cards navigate, 9 regression routes 200 with zero console errors. One real frontend bug found: challenge starter SQL is invalid.

minor.issue: Spec in review request expected final_state='InArrears' for 3 x Fail with max_attempts=4, but implementation only enters InArrears when consecutive_failures >= max_attempts, so 3 fails/4 attempts returns 'Retrying'. Verified InArrears + arrears_amount=12.99 with max_attempts=3. Confirm which is the intended contract.

ui_bugs.issue: Starter SQL is built as '-- title\n-- description\nSELECT ...' then .replace(/-- /g,'') strips the comment markers, leaving the challenge title/description as bare SQL lines. Clicking Run right after opening any challenge fails with "only read-only SELECT/WITH statements are allowed (got 'CUSTOMER')". Reproduced on c02. Fix: don't inject the prose at all (comments are rejected by the arena guard) — set starter to just the SELECT template, or render the prompt outside the textarea.
No <h1> element on these 6 routes (only Home, Labs and lab pages have one) — a11y/SEO heading hierarchy gap.

action_items: Fix SQL Arena challenge starter SQL so the prefilled query is runnable (remove prose injected into the textarea).
Clarify/align arrears InArrears threshold semantics (consecutive_failures >= max_attempts) with the intended spec.

Do NOT keep new pytest files under /app/backend/tests while iterating — uvicorn --reload watches that dir; my file write caused a reload storm that hung the backend for ~4 min (had to supervisorctl restart backend). Tests now live in /app/tests.
critical_code_review_comments: sql_arena.validate_query: guard is solid (comment rejection, single-statement, SELECT/WITH allowlist, keyword blocklist, PRAGMA query_only, 200-row cap). One gap: `PRAGMA query_only = 1` is issued via db.execute after seeding but PRAGMA is also on the blocklist for user input — fine; however the blocklist would also reject legitimate column/alias names containing blocked words (e.g. an alias named `create_date` is safe due to \b but `SELECT ... AS "REPLACE"` would 400). Low risk, worth a note.
SqlArenaPage line 58: `.replace(/-- /g, '')` on a comment string is a code smell that directly produces invalid SQL — remove.
lab_routes submit(): returns 200 with correct=false for invalid SQL which is reasonable, but the challenge-not-found path correctly 404s. Good.
seed_data_creation: None — SQL Arena uses an in-memory seeded SQLite sandbox; no writes performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend security/engine regression tests live at /app/tests/lab_phase678_security_test.py — run with `cd /app/tests && python -m pytest lab_phase678_security_test.py -o addopts=''` (do not place new test files in /app/backend/tests: uvicorn reload watches it and can hang the backend). Field name for retry delays is delay_before_ms (not delay_ms). Arrears requires subscription_amount. All 3 new lab pages verified working via public URL; only outstanding frontend bug is the SqlArenaPage starter-SQL prose injection.
rca_of_the_issue: SqlArenaPage.openChallenge composes a starter query using SQL line comments for the title/description, then strips the '-- ' prefixes (presumably because the backend guard rejects comments). The result is challenge prose as bare tokens before the SELECT, so validate_query sees the first token as a non-SELECT keyword and rejects the query. Any user clicking Run before editing sees a confusing error. Mitigation: set sql to the plain SELECT template only.
